text:
maya: FYI — we're bringing up q4b-small-v2 on the perf harness this week. Need a curated prompt intake for onboarding evals + dedupe before the quant smoke. Rough targets: 10k evaluation prompts, 1k holdout, 500 golden (senior-labeled), 200 regression cases. Prefer multi-domain coverage and token-distribution parity with prod.
dan: Quick q on dedupe strategy — do we want suffix-preserving dedupe (keep tail context) or full-normalized dedupe? Tokenizer mismatches have been biting q4b in past runs.
maya: leaning suffix-preserving + tokenizer-normalize for hashing. Plan: normalize whitespace & punctuation, then compute 64-bit hash on last 512 tokens. Example ingest command for the pipeline:```bash
./ingest_prompts.py --src s3://redwood-prompt-bank/incoming/model-onboard/ --normalize tokenizer --dedupe suffix --suffix-tokens 512 --out s3://redwood-ingest/q4b_small_v2/ingest.ndjson
```
sophia: I'll set up the golden labeling batch — want schema: intent / format / severity / expected_acceptance (binary) / hallucination_flag? Also need to know if we should preserve model responses for regression labeling.
maya: yes to those fields. Add a boolean field `preserve_response` for the regression set. Golden items should be routed to senior labelers only. Label taxonomy: [intent, slot-filling, multi-turn-coherence, safety].
arun: for quant-aware prep: we should trim very long prompts but preserve suffix markers so end-of-dialog signals stay. Cap effective tokens at 2048 for the q4b quant smoke, add a sentinel token "<END_CTX>" before truncation. This reduces KV-cache variance in INT8 runs.
liam: I'll run a baseline script post-dedupe for BLEU/ROUGE + log-perplexity gap vs float32. Will also capture token distribution histograms to check if dedupe skewed the sample.
labeling-bot: Created labeling batch LB-3421 (500 golden) assigned to team:senior-labelers. ETA: 48h.
sophia: adding labeling config now: priority=high, reviewer_required=true, preserve_response=true, regression_case_field=regression_case. Also enabling `deid_check` for any PII flags.
dan: timeline callout: ingest + dedupe Tue morning, quick QA Tue afternoon, assign labeling Wed morning, label complete by Fri EOD -> quant smoke next Mon? We wanted earlier for Q4 planning.
maya: updated plan to accelerate: ingest Tue morning, dedupe Tue afternoon, label assign Wed morning, small holdout test Wed evening (1k), quant smoke Thu morning. If label backlog forms, fallback: run smoke on a 2k auto-curated subset and re-run full smoke after golden. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled smoke run: q4b-small-v2 @ 2026-03-26T10:00:00Z (job id: smoke-8732).
liam: noted. I'll drop a short bench summary (latency/cost/perf deltas) in this thread after the first run. If anyone has edge-domain prompts to include, drop them in the intake S3 path by EOD Mon.
sophia: ack — will add a 50-case safety-heavy mini-cohort to the golden set.
maya: thanks all — ping me if you need schema examples or the ingest manifest. Link to intake doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboard/prompt-harnessing (use the `ingest` section).
